name: Chaos Faction 2

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three to six players use Host a room for 3 (up to 6) players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.

The host clicks through the menus and picks Deathmatch; player 2 is already Keyboard 2, and players 3 to 6 take the next fighters (their cards still say CPU, but in the match each is its player's, with their name over it). Deathmatch for 2-6 players; Campaign with friends for 1-6 (the host picks the level; friends fight next to player 1). Survival is single-player.
tips: Everyone plays on their own PC with the same keys; the host's mouse runs the menus, and each friend clicks only their own card.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: A brawler with weapons, taunts and shields. Online play runs in Ruffle Together: two to six fighters, one per PC, in Deathmatch, or the campaign together with everyone on player 1's side.
